items.title: James Moody — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Mike Lungo recommended him to me.

ctx.x: Who was the guy who made the light come on for you?
That's just the point. I can't think of his name now, because Mike Lungo recommended him to me. But he – I can't think of his name. But he died from peritonitis. Now isn't that something? You know.
